messages:
harry: Quick check-in after the outage: we need a compact customer-comm guide for postmortem follow-ups. Focus: what auto-publishes, what is on-request, and how we call out recurring issues.

sophia: Agree. Keep public posts one short para. Technical addendum should include sequence, impact metrics, and whether this matches prior incidents.

alec: For recurring detection, propose thresholds: 2x in 30d or 3x in 90d. If hit, add a single-sentence callout in the addendum with owner + ETA.

maria: +1. Also: redact customer-identifying logs by default; only include on explicit request with signed NDA if needed.

harry: Templates: Public (24h): short neutral summary + "more details in 72h" line. Addendum (72h): timeline, root-cause summary, mitigations, recurrence status. Full RCA: on-request only, intake form required.

sophia: Where to store templates: incidents/docs/comms-templates.md and a status-page snippet for fast copy/paste.

ops-bot: Suggestion: I can auto-tag threads when similarity score > threshold and post a recurrence notice. Need eng-ml scoring endpoint and permission to label.

alec: I'll sync with eng-ml for the scoring model and share a minimal signature (error-code + service + stack-hash).

maria: Action items: harry -> publish public summary (due_ts: 2434562600); alec -> start addendum draft (due_ts: 2434728400); sophia -> add templates to repo (due_ts: 2434566000); maria -> create intake form skeleton (due_ts: 2434650000).

harry: I'll post the public summary now and link it here when done.

ops-bot: Public summary posted to status page at 2434562400 (https://status.redwood.example/incident/2434561234).

sophia: One more note: SLA-credit escalation thresholds need a clear owner. alec, can you propose numbers for review?

alec: Will propose by EOD.

harry: Thanks everyone. I'll convert these to a short SOP and create action items in the tracker. Close if no objections.

sophia: No objections.

maria: all good.
